prompt: I've been running `claude plugin marketplace update founder-skills` for over a week and it always succeeds, but my plugin still loads the old version (0.2.0). Github's clearly at a newer commit. I ran `cpd --json --no-progress --no-log-file` and its output is in `cpd-output.json`. Walk me through what's happening and what to do.

assertions.name: identifies the silent-cooldown / #46081 root cause
assertions.description: Output explicitly identifies that the standard refresh is silently failing (HTTP 304/429/cooldown variant of Anthropic issue #46081 — naming the issue or the silent-failure mechanism counts).

assertions.name: recommends cpd refresh --force-fetch --yes
assertions.description: Output proposes `cpd refresh founder-skills --force-fetch --yes` (or equivalent — the marketplace name, --force-fetch, and --yes are all required for the recommendation to be actionable).

assertions.name: surfaces destructive nature and asks for confirmation
assertions.description: The response flags that --force-fetch writes to .git/ (or otherwise treats this as a destructive/manual-confirmation step), and asks the user to confirm BEFORE running rather than just running it.

assertions.name: mentions backup behavior
assertions.description: Output reassures the user that --force-fetch backs up .git/HEAD and the origin ref before resetting (the safety property that justifies the destructive op).

assertions.name: presents fix in plain English
assertions.description: Output translates the JSON into natural language. Does not present the diagnosis as a raw JSON paste.
